description.value:
You can inspire others through stirring words or music. As a Bonus Action on your turn, choose one creature other than yourself within 60 feet of you who can hear you. That creature gains one Heroic Inspiration Die, a d6.

Once within the next 10 minutes, the creature can roll the die and add the number rolled to one Ability Check, Attack Roll, or Saving Throw they make. The creature can wait until after it rolls the d20 to decide to use the Heroic Inspiration Die, but must decide before the DM says whether the roll succeeds or fails. Once the Heroic Inspiration Die is rolled, it is lost. A creature can have only one (set of in the case of 2d6) Heroic Inspiration Die at a time.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma Modifier, minimum of once. You regain any expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

Your Heroic Inspiration Die changes when you reach certain Hero levels in this class as shown in the Heroic Presence Table.
